title: SQL Day 1 Coding Arena — Retrieval & Analytical Outputs

questions.scenario: A morning sales review needs a transaction extract.
questions.request: Return order ID, customer, category, sales, and profit for every order.
questions.validation: Correct columns and row-level values from orders.

questions.scenario: Finance needs readable metric names in an export.
questions.request: Return sales as Revenue and profit as Profit.

questions.scenario: Finance wants the non-profit portion of each transaction.
questions.request: Return order ID and sales minus profit as Estimated_Cost.

questions.scenario: Management wants an order-level margin view.
questions.request: Return order ID, sales, profit, and profit divided by sales as Profit_Margin.

questions.scenario: Leadership needs a compact transaction dataset.
questions.request: Return order ID, customer, region, sales, profit, and discount amount calculated as sales * discount.

questions.scenario: The customer team is preparing a transaction-level customer review.
questions.request: Return customer name, product name, quantity, and sales for each transaction.

questions.scenario: A profitability extract will feed a downstream dashboard.
questions.request: Return order ID, sales, profit, and a calculated profit margin. Name the calculated field Profit_Margin and keep the original fields.

questions.scenario: A downstream process expects a strict field order.
questions.request: Produce exactly Order_ID, Customer, Category, Region, Revenue, Profit in that order using aliases.

questions.scenario: Leadership wants an auditable transaction extract.
questions.request: Return the requested business fields plus Estimated_Cost = sales - profit and Profit_Margin = profit / sales, with no unnecessary source columns.
questions.validation: Correct grain, calculations, aliases, and no extra columns.

questions.scenario: The director gives a verbal requirement for a transaction profitability review.
questions.request: Build the final order-level extract containing order ID, customer, category, region, sales, profit, discount, discount amount, and profit margin.
questions.validation: All requested outputs are present and calculations are correct.
